candidates.description: This vector is related to cultural heritage, history, and societal traditions across different languages.
This feature vector represents the concept of having a strong effect, impact, or relevance on outcomes or subjects.
This vector is related to abstract thoughts, philosophical concepts, and intellectual ideas.
This vector represents words related to importance, significance, and magnitude across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents words that function as intensifiers or adverbs of degree across multiple languages.
This feature vector activates on textual abbreviations and terms referring to illustrations or diagrams, particularly variations of the word "figure."
These tokens represent spatial and temporal prepositions indicating relative positions, locations, or relationships.
These tokens represent Devanagari half-consonants and dependent vowel signs used as combining characters in Indic scripts.
These tokens represent nominal and adverbial suffixes found across Romance and Germanic languages.
This vector activates for words and morphemes related to Greek culture, history, geography, and mythology.
